title: The person's responses
description: The person's actions after `after` (stored `act` lines, which include `grant` and `deny` answers to the caller's requests), each batch up to a Send sorted by card number. `more` is true when `limit` cut the list, which it cuts in ledger order: read the rest with `after` set to the highest `seq` in `responses`. A wait that timed out answers `{ responses: [], head }`.

responses.description: The person's actions after `after`. Each batch, up to and ending with its Send, is sorted by card number: a note on a group at its lowest card, a note on or the layout of a whole container at the lowest card in it (first when it holds none), grant answers after the cards; acts on one card in the order made. ✓ reads `check` and ✗ reads `cross`: the person's two marks, which mean what the card you wrote asks. Each card's ✓, ✗, Later and clear (`reopen`) come folded to its latest, and only when it leaves the card otherwise than it was at `after`; notes come one by one.

reported.description: One stored `act` line as the agent reads it: ✓ and ✗ as `mark`, every other act as stored (`act`).

mark.description: The person's ✓ (`check`) or ✗ (`cross`) on a card: a stored `ack` or `drop` line named at the edge. They carry no meaning of their own; the card says what each one means. With `proposal`, it accepts that proposal.

act.description: Any other stored `act` line, as stored.

action.description: Which action the person took: every one but ✓ and ✗, which come as `mark`.
